reviews.t: Pills easily, even before it's washed
reviews.x: It looks nice on but runs large. I ordered a small but it was just too big everywhere except bust. I realize it is a supposed to flow but there was just too much. I used a clasp in the back and it helped a bit. I'm not sure if they offered an XS or not but I would definitely go down a size. Also, I wore it 2 times without washing it and notice pilling in the arms and areas that rub against each other. I plan to hand wash and may be able to wear it once or twice more.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the product's value and performance, often comparing it favorably to more expensive tools.
Several reviewers report their device malfunctioned or died shortly after purchase.
Multiple reviewers highlight excellent customer service, with the company replacing defective units free of charge.
Some reviewers note the product does not heat up enough or takes too long to reach temperature.
Reviewers appreciate the 2-in-1 design that replaces multiple hair tools.
